purpose: Separate (A) an independent, spread-out cultivated host occurrence footprint missing from the frozen WCVP Florida listing, from (B) actual larval use of that host at a documented garden site.

original_data.source: iNaturalist public original observation IDs from prior frozen 2010-2025 Florida pilot
original_data.source_confirmation: Retrieve all original observation IDs (not new opportunistic records); compare taxon, captive flag, date and photo availability with archived pilot

original_observation_requirements: exact Senna polyphylla or infraspecific taxon
independence_metrics: largest fraction of original plant records contributed by one observer
unique observer x approx5km spatial cell
unique approx5km cells and distinct observed years
primary_quality.robustness_gate: At least 10 distinct public observer IDs, >=4 distinct years, >=10 distinct observer x approx5km cells; no observer contributes >50% of original 59 observations.
primary_quality.non_inference: No claim of independently transplanted individuals or garden sites; observations and observers may repeatedly report the same plant and iNaturalist captive tag may be wrong.

consumer_specificity.reason: Both are documented reared on cultivated nonnative Senna in Koptur et al 2024, but plant occurrence alone is not larval use.
consumer_specificity.source: iNaturalist Florida wild/uncaptive observations 2010-2025 annotated Life Stage=Larva (term_id=1,term_value_id=6), with original observation fields
consumer_specificity.coverage_rule: Return total_results and number scanned; when total exceeds cap, absence of linkage among scanned records is NOT evidence of absence in Florida
consumer_specificity.explicit_association: Only an original observation field named Eating/Feeding on/Interaction->Herbivore of/Associated observation with exact Senna polyphylla (or iNaturalist plant taxon 335152 or an original frozen plant observation URL) counts as a candidate direct trophic observation; retain source ID and text for later human source/photo adjudication.
consumer_specificity.separate_diagnostic: Spatial co-observation within 2km and +/-365d may be listed as context but must NOT be classified as feeding, reproduction or causal host support.
consumer_specificity.no_automatic_success: Even an explicit feeding field is an observer assertion; source images and life stage need independent verification. Adult emergence at source site requires rearing, not iNaturalist annotation.

ecological_claim_gate: Consumer-specific horticultural pathway remains a hypothesis unless multiple independently verified larval feeding records and independent survival/rearing outcomes link cultivated, wild-range-unlisted hosts to butterfly reproduction.
reference_study: Koptur et al 2024 DOI 10.3390/insects15020123. Its plant hosts were cultivated for both native and introduced origin groups; published parasitoid Table 1 has arithmetic conflicts. It does not identify cultivated vs naturalized plant treatment effect.
interpretation_boundaries: Do not infer butterfly abundance, occupancy or fitness from presence-only volunteer records
No spatial enrichment p-value from mismatched observation effort
Do not alter main GEB paper
Do not widen taxon list or search time span after seeing outcome
